credit.noneDue: No open credit: every account is settled.
credit.over90: {{count}} customer(s) have owed for more than 90 days: {{amount}} ({{pct}}% of total due) — {{names}}.
credit.d61_90: {{count}} customer(s) have 61–90 day debts: {{amount}} — {{names}}. Follow up before they pass 90 days.
credit.overLimit: {{count}} customer(s) are over their credit limit: {{names}}.
credit.revokedOwes: {{count}} customer(s) lost credit privileges but still owe {{amount}} — {{names}}.
credit.noPayment60: {{count}} customer(s) have made no payment for more than 60 days ({{amount}} due) — {{names}}.
credit.concentration: The top 3 debtors hold {{pct}}% of the total due: {{names}}.
credit.collectionRate: Collection rate on the accounts shown: {{pct}}% ({{settled}} collected of {{charged}} charged).

sales.noSales: No sales in the selected period.
sales.up: Net sales are up {{pct}}%: {{current}} vs {{previous}} in the previous period.
sales.down: Net sales are down {{pct}}%: {{current}} vs {{previous}} in the previous period.
sales.driverChecks: The change comes mostly from the number of checks: {{checks}} vs {{prevChecks}} ({{checkPct}}%). The average check moved less ({{avg}} vs {{prevAvg}}).
sales.driverAverage: The change comes mostly from the average check: {{avg}} vs {{prevAvg}} ({{avgPct}}%). The number of checks moved less ({{checks}} vs {{prevChecks}}).
sales.bestDayPart: The strongest day part is "{{part}}": {{amount}}, {{pct}}% of sales.
sales.highDiscounts: Discounts and coupons are {{pct}}% of sales ({{amount}}), above the {{limit}}% threshold. See the Discount report.
sales.highVoids: Voids are {{pct}}% of sales ({{amount}}), above the {{limit}}% threshold. See the Voids report.
sales.deferred: {{amount}} ({{pct}}% of sales) was not collected: {{room}} to rooms, {{credit}} to customer credit.

voids.topReason: Most frequent reason: "{{reason}}" ({{count}} times, {{amount}}, {{pct}}% of voided amount).
voids.cashierConcentration: {{name}} accounts for {{pct}}% of the voided amount ({{count}} voids, {{amount}}). Worth checking.
voids.withoutComment: {{count}} void(s) without a comment ({{pct}}%). Ask for an explanation every time.

products.none: No items sold in this period.
products.top3: The top 3 sellers make {{pct}}% of revenue: {{names}}.
products.lowSellers: {{count}} item(s) sold {{max}} times or fewer: {{names}}. Worth reviewing on the menu.

servers.bestAverage: Best average check: {{name}} ({{avg}}, vs {{team}} for the team).
servers.lowAverage: Average check well below the team average ({{team}}): {{names}}. Idea: suggest drinks and desserts.
servers.heavyReductions: High discounts compared with the team ({{team}}% on average): {{names}}. See the Discount report.

tables.best: Most profitable table: {{table}} with {{amount}} ({{pct}}% of revenue, {{orders}} orders).
tables.top5: The top 5 tables make {{pct}}% of revenue (out of {{count}} tables used).
tables.noTable: {{amount}} ({{pct}}%) comes from orders without a table: {{types}}.
tables.quiet: {{count}} table(s) were used only once or twice: {{names}}.

weekly.best: Best day: {{day}} with {{amount}} ({{pct}}% of the week).
weekly.worst: Weakest day: {{day}} with {{amount}}, vs {{avg}} on average.
weekly.weekend: The weekend (Saturday + Sunday) makes {{pct}}% of the week ({{amount}}).
weekly.voids: Voids this week: {{amount}} ({{pct}}% of sales). See the Voids report.

tips.top: {{name}} received the most: {{amount}} ({{pct}}% of distributed tips).
tips.average: {{avg}} per person on average, across {{count}} beneficiaries.
tips.gap: Gap between recorded tips ({{total}}) and distributed tips ({{distributed}}): {{gap}}. Check the distributions.

discounts.top: Most used discount: "{{name}}" ({{count}} times, {{amount}}, {{pct}}% of total).
discounts.applierConcentration: {{name}} applied {{pct}}% of the discount amount ({{amount}}). Worth checking.
discounts.withoutReason: {{count}} discount(s) without a reason ({{pct}}%). Require a reason every time.
discounts.selfApproved: {{count}} discount(s) approved by the same person who applied them: {{names}}.
discounts.average: Average discount: {{avg}} per discounted order ({{orders}} orders).

customers.top: Top customer: {{name}} with {{amount}} ({{pct}}% of total, {{orders}} orders).
customers.top10: The top 10 customers make {{pct}}% of total (out of {{count}} named customers).
customers.regulars: {{count}} customer(s) came 3 times or more, for {{amount}} in total.
customers.avgCompare: Average check of a named customer: {{named}}, vs {{anonymous}} for an anonymous one.
customers.anonymous: {{pct}}% of sales have no named customer. Entering the customer more often would make this report and credit more useful.

expenses.uncategorized: {{count}} expense(s) without a category ({{amount}}). Categorizing them makes tracking clearer.
expenses.perClosing: {{avg}} of expenses per closing on average ({{count}} closings).

activity.approvals: {{count}} action(s) ({{pct}}%) needed a manager's approval, most often {{name}} ({{managerCount}} times).

productList.duplicateCodes: {{count}} code(s) used by several items: {{codes}}. Fix them.
productList.allGood: The menu is clean: every item has a price, a category and a unique code.

advanced.reductions: Discounts and coupons: {{amount}} ({{pct}}% of sales before discounts).

advanced.notes: {{count}} order(s) carry a note: use the search to find them.

dashboard.lateOrders: {{count}} order(s) took more than 30 minutes from opening to completion ({{pct}}%).
dashboard.refunds: {{count}} refunded order(s) in this period. Check the reasons.

shifts.noSales: {{count}} shift(s) of at least one hour with no sale: {{names}}.

advancedReport.search: Search an order (number, person, table, note)…

cashReport.deferredNote: Amounts charged to rooms or credit ({{amount}}) are not in the balance: they are not collected yet.

shiftsReport.note: An order counts for the person who took the payment (else the order taker), in the shift they had open at that time. Orders paid with no open shift appear on a "no clock-in" row, so the total always matches every paid order in the period.

cashAudit.windowLabel: A change is flagged if it happens less than…
cashAudit.empty: No suspicious change in this period.
cashAudit.explanation: An order is flagged when, less than {{minutes}} minutes before it was paid in cash, an item was removed or the payment changed. It is not proof: it is a list to check (typing mistake, guest changing their mind…).

kitchenTiming.explanation: Order time: from opening to payment. Prep time: from sent to kitchen to ready. The "9 in 10" column shows how long the worst-served guests wait, more telling than the average.
